Surrey AC retained the team title thanks to storming runs by Dave Gibson and John Snowden on the last two laps. Once again the time-keeping was suspect and several of the times were shuffled about--in one report Tony Fairclough was credited with third fastest time!
Mel Thorpe,running in Belgrave colours for the first time on the Brighton road,was faced with the problem of dealing with Reynolds of Portsmouth and John Snowden of Surrey.
